notes.title: April Fools Update (can be disabled)
notes.notes:
Hello Kings & Queens,

It is April Fools today, so I figured to celebrate the 1 week since launch for Le Château, I would make this super cozy experience temporarily a super intense experience; a clicker game. Place buildings like how you always would. But...keep clicking them...because otherwise they will slowly shrink >:)

Enjoy!

(it can be disabled by pressing the enabled button in the bottom left! happy building!)

TheShelfman

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Changes:


Tutorial step about achievement panel no longer blocks the button text preview at the bottom of the screen


Fixes:


Fixed Color palette button staying in place rather than moving to the edge of the screen
Fixed achievements sometimes not being recognized and therefore unlocking tiles (I really hope it’s been fixed!)
Fixed Ocean Time achievement tiles already being unlocked from the start
Fixed 11 tile world achievement unlocking 9, 7, and 5 tile world achievement as well (same for 9 unlocking 7 and 5, and 7 unlocking 5)

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Changes:

Changed stable default rotation by 90 degrees
Changed default order in which objects is shown
After placing an object, it no longer automatically switches to the next object in line
Added a sound that plays with every tutorial step popup
Tutorial step on rotating the world now requires you to rotate the world twice
When it’s raining, the background is now darker, and there’s a 50% chance that the lighting is also darker
Added button that allows you to change the current color palette



Fixes:

Screenshot button is now also available after build is finished
Rain sound effect now loops
Snow sound effect now loops
Fixed worlds looking weird when spawning tiles on a rotated world in the tutorial
Fixed 1 tile circle world build animations not working
